method_caveats: Keyword overlap is a coarse, disclosed heuristic (shared content words between the generated follow-up and a hand-written description of the probed gap), not a semantic or human-judged groundedness measurement. It can under-detect true grounding but cannot over-detect it beyond incidental word overlap.

N=12 constructed cases (15 generate_followup() calls after repeats) plus 1 skip-predicate verification -- indicative of current qualitative behavior across evidence categories, not a powered or statistically analyzed study, and not a random or representative sample of real candidate answers.

Subjective rubric dimensions (technical correctness, specificity, answerability, evidence grounding beyond keyword overlap, non-redundancy beyond the coarse flag above, target relevance) are NOT scored by this script. They are read and rated manually in a separate companion pass after this script runs, and that manual pass is a single, non-blinded read by the same research agent that built this probe -- not an independent or expert rating, and not to be cited as such.

The strong-answer skip case does not call generate_followup(); it is verified by re-applying the production gate predicate (quoted in SKIP_PREDICATE_SOURCE) to a constructed eval_result, since production itself never calls generate_followup() in that situation.

The repeat-run variability check (3 same-input calls for 2 cases) uses the real GGUF sampling settings (temperature=0.1, top_p=0.9, no explicit per-call seed) and is a within-session observation of 2 cases, not a systematic study of generation stability.
